issue.summary: Native PDF: map and topic File properties are not available in metadata.xml
issue.description: Native PDF temp metadata.xml receives only the output preset Metadata tab values and omits the Advanced tab File (Asset) properties, so selected source properties and the source map path do not reach Native PDF. Continuation of the sourceProps metadata.xml contract from GUIDES-17324 and GUIDES-17997 and the preset file-metadata configuration from GUIDES-3704.
